intro.features_description: StingStream works with a few optional services. You will find them in Settings:
intro.jellyseerr_feature_description: Connect to your Seerr instance and request movies directly in the app.
intro.downloads_feature_description: Download movies and series to watch offline.
intro.chromecast_feature_description: Cast movies and series to your Chromecast devices.
intro.centralised_settings_plugin_description: Settings can be managed centrally on your server. Every device syncs automatically.
intro.crash_reports_description: StingStream sends anonymous crash and error reports to the developers when this is turned on. No account data or server addresses are included. You can turn this off here or anytime in settings.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.download_live_activity_hint: Show download progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
appearance.merge_next_up_continue_watching_hint: Combine Continue Watching and Next Up into a single home row.
appearance.use_episode_images_next_up: Use episode images for Next Up & Continue Watching
appearance.use_episode_images_next_up_hint: Show each episode's own thumbnail in the Next Up and Continue Watching rows instead of the series image.
appearance.hide_remote_session_button_hint: Hide the remote-sessions button from the home header.
appearance.show_hero_carousel_hint: Show the large swipeable carousel at the top of the home screen.

network.location_off_description: Connected to Wi-Fi, but the network name is hidden. Enable device Location services and grant the app location permission to detect it.

video_player.title: Video player
video_player.native_note: Both options use the same MPV engine, this only changes the player controls. The native player uses native system controls and opens instantly. Switch back if you run into playback issues.
video_player.exoplayer_note: ExoPlayer does not support advanced ASS/SSA subtitle styling or horizontal subtitle alignment. Switch to MPV if you need those.
video_player.mpv_note: MPV on TV does not currently pass HDR metadata to the display, so HDR10/HDR10+ content is tone-mapped to SDR. Switch to ExoPlayer for HDR output.
video_player.native_tv_note: Use the new fully-native Apple TV player. Turn it off to fall back to the previous player if you run into playback issues.
video_player.native_android_tv_note: Use the new fully-native Android TV player. Turn it off to fall back to the previous player if you run into playback issues.

gesture_controls.double_tap_to_seek_description: Double tap the left or right side of the video to skip backward or forward
gesture_controls.hide_volume_slider_description: Hide the volume slider in the video player
gesture_controls.hide_brightness_slider_description: Hide the brightness slider in the video player

subtitles.subtitles_on_mute_hint: Turn subtitles on automatically while the sound is off, and turn them back off when it returns.
subtitles.subtitles_on_mute_allow_restart_hint: Some subtitle formats cannot be turned on without the server re-processing the stream, which briefly interrupts playback. Turning this on lets it happen automatically when the sound is muted.
subtitles.subtitle_background_hint: Adds a semi-transparent black background behind subtitles

music.title: Music
music.caching_description: Store upcoming queue songs ahead of time. The oldest ones are removed once the size limit is reached.

plugins.wikidata_awards_hint: Show Oscar and award status on movie and series pages. This device asks Wikidata directly, not your server.
plugins.opensubtitles_enabled_hint: Let this device search OpenSubtitles directly when your server has no subtitle provider. Turning this off keeps subtitle searches on your server and leaves any saved API key alone.
plugins.crash_reports_hint: Send anonymous crash and error reports to the StingStream developers via Sentry, when configured. Reports contain no account data; server addresses and tokens are removed before anything is sent.

jellyseerr.api_key_hint: Alternative to the password: a Seerr admin API key connects you as your account directly. Requires a recent Seerr server.

jellyseerr.auto_login_description: Sign in to Seerr on launch using your server password. The password is kept in the device's secure storage and removed when you log out.

storage.clear_all_cache_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to clear all cached data? This will clear all cached images, music files, subtitles, and query caches. Your settings and login session will be kept.

groups.members_hint: "Direct" means bytes travel peer to peer; "relayed" means they pass through a relay, which still works but costs someone bandwidth. A member with no path yet is simply one nothing has been asked of.
groups.members_empty_hint: Share an invite code to add one.
groups.members_unavailable: This server could not be asked who is in the group: {{message}}
groups.remove_member_warning: {{name}} loses access to {{group}} immediately, and the group's secret is rotated so it cannot get back in. Every invite code handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. There is no undo: the only way back is a fresh invite.
groups.removing_member: Removing {{name}} and rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.
groups.member_removed_result: {{name}} removed. {{n}} members took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
groups.rotate_secret_warning: Every invite code handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. Nobody is removed: every current member is handed the new secret, and the ones that are asleep take it the next time they connect.
groups.rotating_secret: Rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.
groups.rotate_secret_result: Secret rotated. {{n}} members took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
groups.secret_never_rotated: The secret has never been rotated · epoch {{epoch}}
